prime-factorization-calculator.quickAnswer: Prime factorization breaks a number into the prime numbers that multiply to make it. Divide out 2 as many times as possible, then 3, 5, 7 and so on, counting how many times each divides evenly. The result is unique: every number has exactly one prime factorization.
prime-factorization-calculator.tagline: Break any number into its prime building blocks.
prime-factorization-calculator.workedExample:
Factorize 60.

60 / 2 = 30, 30 / 2 = 15 — so 2 appears twice.
15 / 3 = 5 — so 3 appears once.
5 is prime.

60 = 2^2 x 3 x 5.

Check: 4 x 3 x 5 = 60. Correct.
